schema_semantics.digest: New HOB source-vector digest is SHA256 of UTF8 canonical JSON: object keys sorted, no whitespace, ensure_ascii=false; vector ordered by exact repository_ref, no name/path-derived identity. Existing Forge manifest/plan digests retain their qualified owner algorithm and are opaque refs, not recomputed with HOB rules.
schema_semantics.refs: All opaque refs resolved only against configured authenticated owning instance/contract/caller scope; never arbitrary URLs/SSRF, caller supplied actor roles, self-issued receipts or peer filesystem.
schema_semantics.basic_link: DiscoverySnapshot→TopologySnapshot. Current access and exactly one committed authority verified; save own reference, no fabricated operation/plan/Mission. For pure project read snapshots operation_ref/plan_ref are null.
schema_semantics.inspection: INSPECT_READ resolves AnalysisPlan with scripts/network/transfer forbidden and zero external cost; ASSESSMENT resolves separately accepted tools/profile/version/isolation/budget. Request plan/source digest must match immutable owner record; client cannot amend limits through an arbitrary object.
schema_semantics.limits: Absolute owner expiry and fixed maximum elapsed time include pauses/restarts. Limits cannot exceed current accepted authorization/owner budget; attempts do not reset on retry. Unknown nested field/tool/profile/ref refused before effects.
schema_semantics.model_transfer: EXPLICIT_MODEL_CONSENT requires resolvable current TransferConsent; exact verified actor/data-owner-transfer scope/vector/payload digest/classes/recipient/model/purpose/retention/cost/expiry all match. Different recipient/content, absent/expired/revoked consent → 403 or SOURCE_ONLY only when explicitly selected; never silent model upload or network fallback. Reuse prior valid exact consent; no redundant harmless read confirmation.
schema_semantics.decisions: APPROVE/REJECT/ABSTAIN explicit; verified roles derive from current auth. Payload digest binds exact subject and decision contents. Disposition preserves decline/supersedes/history; accepted risk expires and cannot waive applicable current acceptance. Deferral trigger mandatory; resolved proof mandatory.
schema_semantics.topology: Exactly one authority repository equals project.authority_repository_id; every listed repo shares same project/authority, attachments only refer listed repos, no duplicated IDs or paths as identity. A malformed/conflicting set is CONFLICT, not closest match.
schema_semantics.joins: OwnerRef/ReadScope owner+instance must match configured authenticated peer and viewer; source vector digest exact; references share logical project/plan/source/operation. Per-owner monotone revisions; no global atomic snapshot. Relay preserves original EP digest/vector/observed_at and current EP permitted disclosure; fetched_at does not refresh evidence.
schema_semantics.cache: After revoke/expiry/scope switch increment viewer epoch and conceal protected cache; late callbacks for old epoch/current access cannot restore it. Durable redacted intent remains for supported original operation only.

owner_resolution_requirements: GET topology expected_topology_revision is transported as query integer; mismatch409. Discovery has optional scoped cursor/limit; it returns current authorized page, not caller-selected private identity.
GET context expected_source_vector_digest and evidence_snapshot_bundle_ref resolve immutable owner refs/vectors under current actor visibility; wrong/unavailable bundle fails, not invented fallback.
GET progress relay operation_id/ep_snapshot_ref/expected_source_vector_digest transported query; exact EP original bytes/digest/vector/instance/observed_at checked, unknown refs refuse.

INSPECT_READ plan requires network/scripts/transfer forbidden and externalcost0. ASSESSMENT separately accepted plan/profile/tool/isolation/limits; changed plan digest/revision or greater request scope refuses.

DecisionRequest and DispositionRequest are canonical payloads hashed with subject/version and bound receipt. Unknown nested fields reject. Owner CAS checks current subject revision and validated source vector.

A producer must define/qualify owner record preparation/consent issuance with real existing scoped authority before these references can be used. This proposal does not authorize client-issued records; absent producer support blocks that implementation edge, with source-only discussion as alternative.

HOB-EP02 analysis-plans prepare stores a non-executable proposal under existing scoped inspection rights, computes owner digest and validates tools/isolation/limits. It cannot authorize assessment. Its decisions route requires CURRENT preexisting accepted admission role/scope and exact plan/source, preserves APPROVE/REJECT/ABSTAIN, returns owner receipt; no self-issued grant or scope increase. Unsupported pre-identity authority remains explicit blocked producer edge.

HOB-F03 transfer-consents decision verifies CURRENT data-owner disclosure rights and model/recipient/budget policy independently from source-read rights. Source read alone cannot approve transfer. Owner stamps actor/owner/ref/state/expiry, clamps/refuses requested expiry/cost outside existing rights; decision refusal is retained and never grants upload. Exact valid prior consent may be reused.

A TransferConsent is an immutable consent record plus current revocation check, not a bearer credential. Existing supported private owner issuance/conveyance stays separate and never becomes a token input in the wizard.

All data refs resolve at trusted configured owning HTTP origin and exact scope; an untrusted artifact cannot insert a URL, override principal or widen access. Tool registry/baseline refs retain their own version/provenance and are not mislabeled project analysis; joins apply matching source vectors to operation/report evidence.

Consent preparation routes are proposed on both owning products: Forge handles model interpretation consent, EP handles external scanner disclosure consent. Network/tool permission alone cannot disclose source/report data. Matching exact active owner-issued consent required for external payload transfer; no SOURCE_ONLY request uploads data.

AnalysisPlanPrepareRequest has proposal content and expected source/plan revision; owner computes immutable PlanRef/digest. It never trusts caller-stamped accepted state or requires a preexisting project/plan to propose bounded pre-identity inspection.

TransferConsentDecisionResult retains explicit approve/refuse receipt; consent_record=null for REJECT/ABSTAIN. APPROVE returns only an owner-stamped ACTIVE bounded record, never a bearer or new privilege. Current actor must independently possess disclosure rights.

Goal-only new-project chat resolves an own Workspace draft evidence reference under explicitly qualified Forge draft-advice scope, with no repository vector and no EP identity claim. SourceVector[] is permitted only for actual no-repo draft context; inspection/setup/baseline requests require nonempty source vectors. If draft advice support/consent is absent, keep own draft/static questions and show unavailable advice; no fake project grant or provider call.

Draft intent statements are user-declared input, never instructions/role/approval. Detect/redact sensitive text before chat persistence/transfer; unclassified or secret payload cannot go to model/export. A goal-only transfer consent has empty repo vector, USER_DECLARED_GOAL only, DRAFT_ADVICE purpose and current actual own-data rights.

All POST intents, including plan/interpretation/decision/consent preparation, use stable operation_id/idempotency_key and immutable request digest. Owner atomically records original intent before effect, reserves bounded model/tool budget once per original operation, and serves original result after lost reply; unknown provider effect does not authorize another call. Readback never issues a grant or increments budget.

Prepared/accepted record is not new authority. Current owner verifies preexisting actor/role/source/disclosure/admission scope; no client-stamped actor/ACTIVE owner record accepted. Actual issuer/pre-project scope qualification remains a concrete missing producer edge, not a global project initialization prerequisite.

EP evidence GET is a proposed scoped redacted structured view, not widening current accepted-consumer artifact bearer or arbitrary raw report download. Forge finding GET resolves exact baseline/vector under own read scope. Preserve original issue/tool owner/status/ref, no issue close on read.

Consumers may retain only bounded short-lived authorized display cache and durable refs, not a second canonical engineering store; no raw source/secret/prompt/hostpath export. Provenance and redaction transforms retain original owner evidence refs/digests separately.

original_intent_readback.semantics: Authenticated same caller/owner original request; unknown remains EFFECT_UNCERTAIN/NOT_FOUND, never permission to issue another key. Completed exact result referenced by immutable evidence. All POST bodies persist operation/key/digest before provider or decision effects; same key/different bytes409; duplicates use original result after current-access validation.
